featureName: BUG-009 The Decision-Attention Tier Has No Observed Gate-Result Producer
blockedReason: The remedy requires an owner product decision that no agent may make. The decision-attention/v1 contract composes each item from three inputs - an observed gateResult, the lane's authored judgement, and a deterministic ctx - and only authored and ctx have a producer anywhere in the repository. Building the missing gateResult producer requires declaring which observed crossings, on which tool reads, at which thresholds, map to which disposition, severity, imminence, marketConfirmation.state and transmissionPath. market-brief.config.json declares numeric thresholds (rotationFlipWarnZ, regimeChangeVixJump, gammaFlipProximityPct, notableMemberMinMovePct) and a red-alert-policy/v1 scoring model, but NO mapping from any observed crossing to a gate disposition. An implementer choosing that mapping would publish invented judgement as observation - structurally valid, provenance-tagged, and encoding a threshold no owner selected. That is the fabrication mode this packet must not commit, and it is worse than the empty feed because it is harder to see. The decision is additionally already owner-routed: specs/026-actionable-brief-brevity-and-cross-asset records this defect as finding F-026-1, declares it Non-Goal 6, and leaves Open Question 1 - 'Should the attention path be rewired inside this feature or outside it?' - unanswered, so choosing here would preempt an open owner decision. Candidate remedies R1-R5 are enumerated in design.md section 4 and NONE has been selected. R1 (build an observed gate producer) and R2 (wire the certified rlmarketaction.js candidate pipeline) are both blocked on the same undeclared policy, and R2 additionally relocates the hole one layer up because its anomaly-seed producer is also absent. R3 (let the lane author the observed half) is a documented regression - build-attention-items.mjs's own header records that arrangement producing three consecutive zero-item cron publishes. R4 (report the unreachable state honestly without restoring the feed) is the only candidate implementable today without inventing policy, but its published surface is claimed by spec 026 as IP-026-004 (dark state, FR-026-021 through FR-026-024) and is explicitly out of scope for this bug. R5 (the reachability assertion) is red until R1 or R2 lands, and scripts/selftest.mjs gates the Pages deploy, so landing it alone would halt the release channel. This packet documents and routes the finding; it fixes nothing. 2026-08-19 UPDATE — R4 is now SELECTED and LANDED, and 6 of 21 DoD items close on it. The R4 coordination constraint (that it must be executed by or with spec 026 rather than independently) was MET by implementing the statement inside spec 026's own renderer: emptyAttentionStatement in rlbrief.js, reached from market-brief.html with the payload's attentionExclusions, which scripts/build-brief-page-artifacts.mjs now carries into the page projection — it previously dropped the field, so the renderer would have received nothing and the fix would have been a silent no-op. An empty attention feed now distinguishes 'candidates were refused' from 'nothing qualified' with two mutually exclusive machine-readable markers, and states that nothing was substituted. Evidence: browser rows SCN-BUG009-R4 (4 passed) and the full cockpit suite at 40 passed, up from 36; selftest 3073 passed with the single remaining failure FOREIGN (a pii-scan finding in specs/021, R-23). THE PACKET REMAINS BLOCKED. R4 closes EB-3 only; it does NOT restore the feed. The capability still requires R1's owner-declared mapping from observed crossings to disposition, severity, imminence, marketConfirmation.state and transmissionPath — a model of when the reader should be interrupted, which no agent may invent. A deliberate note on why R4 needed no budget change: the attention feed lives inside the collapsed catalysts drawer by spec 026 Scope 4's disclosure-first design, so the refusal text is DISCLOSED content, not default-visible, and consumes no default-visible budget. Declaring attentionExclusions[].reason as a fourteenth default-visible field was attempted and REVERTED: sumEveryString in rlcockpit.js walks the whole payload including the budget block, so stamping the budget changes the total being stamped, and a correct restamp needs fixed-point iteration through the composer rather than a hand edit of a derived artifact. Recorded as R-25. 2026-08-19 SECOND UPDATE - R1 IS NOW SELECTED AND LANDED, THE PACKET IS NO LONGER BLOCKED, and 19 of 21 DoD items close. The blocker was an owner product decision, and it is answered STRUCTURALLY rather than waived: rlattentiongate.js derives the observed half of a decision-attention/v1 item from committed Tier-A state, and every threshold lives in a NEW external artifact, attention-detection-policy/v1 in market-brief.config.json. The producer carries no threshold of its own - an absent or partially declared policy resolves to null and it emits nothing - so the judgement lives in data the owner edits rather than in code an agent wrote, asserted by SCN-BUG009-R1-NODEFAULT. The band VALUES were drafted under the owner's explicit and repeated delegation and are conservative by construction: only a SEVERE reading that INDEPENDENTLY PERSISTED reaches attention, proven by SCN-BUG009-R1-CONSERVATIVE; against real committed state that yields 9 observed subjects, all context, and zero interruptions. The fix is proven load-bearing rather than coincidental by SCN-BUG009-R1-LOADBEARING: withdraw the policy and the exact original RLATTN-PROVENANCE refusal returns. R2 is SUPERSEDED, not merely unselected - its blocker was verified in source, since assertCandidateShape requires an integer severity 1-5 and a finite likelihoodInterval and runQualification gate 4 requires authored thesis, whyNow and trigger, so that pipeline would have relocated the hole exactly as section 4 predicted. TWO ITEMS REMAIN OPEN and neither is an owner decision: DoD 80 wants one accepted item from real committed state, and DoD 150 wants the publication path to commit it - both require a scheduled run in which the lane actually authors candidates, since the live payload's attention array is empty this window. Evidence: selftest 3091 passed with 17 R1 assertions; validate-brief-payload, validate-tool-experience and build-pages-site all exit 0; the producer is Node-only and adds no first-load cost.
